# NPO法人JASIPA (Japan Software Industry Promotion Association)

> > NPO法人JASIPA - Japan's software industry promotion organization connecting domestic and international IT communities, offering consulting services, training programs, and industry collaboration

JASIPA is a non-profit organization that supports the Japanese software industry through regional chapters (関西支部, 関東甲信越支部), specialized committees (DX推進委員会, SES推進委員会, 研修・採用支援委員会), and international partnerships including VNITO Alliance, Philippine Software Industry Association, and IT Ukraine Association. The organization provides business solutions, training programs, and industry networking through initiatives like CIO Lounge and ニッポンクラウドワーキンググループ.

## Key Topics

- JASIPA (Japan Software Industry Promotion Association)
- DX推進委員会 (DX Promotion Committee)
- SES推進委員会 (SES Promotion Committee)
- 研修・採用支援委員会 (Training & Recruitment Support Committee)
- 関西支部 (Kansai Regional Chapter)
- 関東甲信越支部 (Kanto-Koshinetsu Regional Chapter)
- VNITO Alliance (Vietnam-Japan IT cooperation)
- CIO Lounge
- ニッポンクラウドワーキンググループ (Nippon Cloud Working Group)
- 宮城県情報サービス産業協会 (Miyagi IT Services Association)
- Philippine Software Industry Association
- IT Ukraine Association
- 新人研修 (New employee training)
- Manufacturing & logistics consulting
- Security solutions (DEFENDER-X)
